result: The original preview completed, but both Node fetch (20 seconds) and Playwright APIRequestContext (40 seconds) independent authenticated GETs timed out before the import-reference entry trace. The last native context dispatch did not complete before test teardown.
conclusion: Evidence narrows the next investigation to the pending native-context dispatch and possible synchronous work after preview persistence. ERR_ABORTED alone does not prove that original-response capture caused the failure.
instrumentation: Original response capture is unchanged. Added static outer-entry stages, non-sensitive transport metadata and a read-only Node fetch of the original owner-bound reference. The Node probe did not replay admission/preview or supply UI data.
boundary: Disposable CI only; no product/worker trace source changes. Persisted evidence excludes credentials, cookies, response bodies and private domain values.
